conflicts.fact: Size of the gap between planned and actual figures: income versus surplus
conflicts.versions: Lesson 2: actual income was 18,000 against 20,000 planned, so income fell by 2,000. The surplus fell by 2,630, from 5,000 to 2,370. Lesson 3: says Lesson 2 left learners with 'actual income KES 2,630 below the plan' and repeats this in the Predict phase. The 2,630 is the drop in surplus (and in the cash box), not the drop in income.
